cases.why: Real withdrawal. The unit is glued straight onto both figures with no space, the label is glued onto the balance too, and the last line — «مرکزآواي نوين:02162740» — is the bank signing its own call centre, not a merchant: it is on every message the bank sends, and reading it as one titled every اقتصاد نوین transaction «آوای نوین».
